features.name: Login Validation
steps: Attempt login with an invalid account
Log in with a test account
features.expected: Invalid account shows an error message and stays on the login page; valid account enters the product home page

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
steps: Browse the product list on the home page
features.expected: The list shows multiple products; you can open the detail to view the image, price, and description

features.name: Product Search
steps: Enter a keyword with no results
features.expected: The list is filtered by keyword; when there is no match, an empty state is shown instead of an error

features.name: Category Filter
features.expected: The list changes according to the selected category

features.name: Favorite and Persistence
steps: Favorite a product from the detail or list
Restart the App and check the favorites again
features.expected: The favorite state is visible, the favorites list contains the product, and it remains after restart

features.name: Cart Add and Remove
features.expected: After adding, the corresponding entry and correct total appear; after removal, the entry and total update together

features.name: Checkout
steps: Perform a simulated checkout in the cart
features.expected: After checkout the cart is emptied and a new order is created

features.name: Order History and Persistence
steps: Confirm the order number and status
Restart the App and check the orders again
features.expected: The order list contains the just-created order number and status, and it still exists after restart

features.name: Profile
features.expected: Shows the current logged-in user information, the number of favorites and orders, and provides a media showcase and a log-out action

features.name: Logout and Session State
features.expected: After logout, return to the login page; after restart, still in the logged-out state

features.name: Offline Media Playback
features.expected: Both audio and video can be played offline, and the playback state is visible
